title: atractylis japonica
intro: Atractylis japonica, commonly known as Japanese thistle or Japanese hare's ear, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is prized for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Atractylis japonica include its ability to inhibit histamine release, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
